title: Seven Seas Licenses Ushiyama-san, Mouse Royale, This World Is Worth Fighting For, More Manga/Novels

title: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 Drops Final Trailer Ahead of Netflix Launch – Watch
content: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners is only days away from its second season return with Netflix, and one final trailer is helping to show off what fans can expect to see from the new batch of characters.

title: Ei Ohitsuji's Ochibure Zeus to Dorei no Ko Manga Changes Publisher
content: The November issue of Asahi Shimbun Publications ' Nemuki+ magazine announced on Tuesday that Ei Ohitsuji 's Ochibure Zeus to Dorei no Ko ( Fallen Zeus and the Slave Boy ) manga will move to Ichijinsha 's Zero-Sum Online manga website in spring next year.
author: ANN

title: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 New Poster Visual and Trailer Introduce More Characters
content: CYBERPUNK EDGERUNNERS 2 has revealed a new poster key visual and trailer ahead of the show’s October 20, 2026 release. Studio TRIGGER is back to animate, with Netflix set to exclusively stream the series.
author: Anime Corner

title: Blue Eye Samurai Season 2 Expands Cast Ahead of Netflix Release
content: Blue Eye Samurai is now in the works on coming back to Netflix with Season 2 of its animated series run next year, and has now revealed more of the new faces joining the cast for its new season. Blue Eye Samurai has been one of the most notable new releases on Netflix in the last few years.
author: ComicBook

title: AFA Singapore Adds Kagurabachi Anime as Featured Anime
